nodes.text:
Salt eats everything. That's my whole trade in three words.

Buy new, or bring me what the sea's been chewing and I'll see what's left under it.

choices.label: Why not just make it out of something better?

nodes.text:
There isn't anything better. There's only iron that hasn't been in the water yet.

The drowned carry coral through their armor and it holds - grows into the gaps and stops the rot. I've tried it. You can't forge it, you can only be dead long enough to grow it.
